intro.text: This entry describes mitochondrial myopathy with lactic acidosis (MMLA), a clinically defined disorder. The evidence I can recall does not establish a single causal gene.

checks.claim: Mitochondrial myopathy with lactic acidosis (MMLA) is a clinically defined disorder.
checks.explanation: not supported by any of the 10 cited papers. The abstract describes iPLA2gamma knockout mice and does not mention MMLA or how it is defined clinically (abstract only).

checks.claim: No single causal gene has been established for mitochondrial myopathy with lactic acidosis.
checks.explanation: not supported by any of the 10 cited papers. The abstract does not address whether MMLA has a causal gene (abstract only).

paragraphs.text: Mitochondrial myopathy with lactic acidosis is a disorder of skeletal muscle. It causes muscle weakness and exercise intolerance, together with chronically raised blood lactate. Muscle biopsy shows abnormal mitochondria, such as ragged-red fibers and structurally abnormal mitochondria. The biochemical and genetic basis appears to be heterogeneous.

checks.claim: Mitochondrial myopathy with lactic acidosis is a disorder of skeletal muscle.
checks.evidence_quote: A metabolic myopathy associated with chronic lactic acidemia
checks.explanation: The title describes a metabolic myopathy, which implies a muscle disorder. It does not say 'skeletal muscle' and does not use the MMLA label.

checks.claim: Mitochondrial myopathy with lactic acidosis causes muscle weakness.
checks.evidence_quote: a young girl with a suspected mitochondrial myopathy that manifested as progressive muscle weakness, hypotonia, seizures, poor weight gain, and lactic acidosis
checks.explanation: Muscle weakness is described in the single PNPLA8 patient, not as a general feature of MMLA.

checks.claim: Mitochondrial myopathy with lactic acidosis causes exercise intolerance.
checks.explanation: not supported by any of the 10 cited papers. The abstract does not mention exercise intolerance (abstract only).

checks.claim: Mitochondrial myopathy with lactic acidosis is associated with chronically raised blood lactate.
checks.evidence_quote: A metabolic myopathy associated with chronic lactic acidemia
checks.explanation: 'Chronic lactic acidemia' means chronically raised blood lactate.

checks.claim: Muscle biopsy in mitochondrial myopathy with lactic acidosis shows ragged-red fibers.
checks.explanation: not supported by any of the 10 cited papers. The abstract does not mention ragged-red fibers or muscle biopsy; the abnormal mitochondria it describes are in the mouse hippocampus (abstract only).

checks.claim: Muscle biopsy in mitochondrial myopathy with lactic acidosis shows structurally abnormal mitochondria.
checks.evidence_quote: Electron microscopy of muscle tissue showed various mitochondrial abnormalities and accumulation of neutral lipids
checks.explanation: Electron microscopy of the patient's muscle showed mitochondrial abnormalities.

checks.claim: The biochemical and genetic basis of mitochondrial myopathy with lactic acidosis appears to be heterogeneous.
checks.explanation: not supported by any of the 10 cited papers. The abstract does not discuss whether MMLA has a heterogeneous basis (abstract only).

paragraphs.text: The entry is listed with autosomal recessive inheritance, based on reports of affected sibs born to unaffected parents.

checks.claim: Mitochondrial myopathy with lactic acidosis is listed with autosomal recessive inheritance.
checks.evidence_quote: Segregation analysis confirmed that the variants were inherited from carrier parents, consistent with an autosomal recessive inheritance pattern.
checks.explanation: Autosomal recessive inheritance is shown for this one PNPLA8 family, not for MMLA as a listed entity.

checks.claim: Mitochondrial myopathy with lactic acidosis has been reported in affected sibs born to unaffected parents.
checks.explanation: not supported by any of the 10 cited papers. The abstract reports no human families or affected sibs (abstract only).

paragraphs.text: Mitochondrial myopathy with lactic acidosis is a descriptive label. It probably includes disorders with different causes, including defects of the mitochondrial respiratory chain.

checks.claim: Mitochondrial myopathy with lactic acidosis is a descriptive label.
checks.explanation: not supported by any of the 10 cited papers. The abstract does not mention MMLA (abstract only).

checks.claim: Mitochondrial myopathy with lactic acidosis probably includes disorders with different causes.
checks.explanation: not supported by any of the 10 cited papers. The abstract does not discuss what causes MMLA (abstract only).

checks.claim: The causes of mitochondrial myopathy with lactic acidosis include defects of the mitochondrial respiratory chain.
checks.explanation: not supported by any of the 10 cited papers. The abstract does not mention respiratory chain defects or MMLA (abstract only).
